name: Poggio Mirteto (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Poggio Mirteto (a red tower on white above a myrtle bush) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI POGGIO MIRTETO in yellow beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Poggio Mirteto, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Poggio Mirteto arms — red tower on white above a myrtle bush, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI POGGIO MIRTETO beneath the arms
